india-macro.title: India's October Gross GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore
india-macro.summary: India's gross GST collection reached Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October, representing a 22.9% increase from last year. The gross GST collected for the April-October period totaled Rs 14.78 lakh crore, showing a 13.2% growth year-on-year. Maharashtra recorded the highest revenue for October at Rs 35,150 crore, followed by Karnataka and Gujarat. Some states, including Sikkim and Ladakh, experienced significant declines in GST collections during the month.

sectors.title: Festive spending drives record UPI transactions in October
sectors.summary: Festive spending pushed UPI transactions to a record 25.47 billion in October, up 23% year-on-year, while transaction value rose 16% to a record ₹31.53 lakh crore, according to NPCI data. Average daily transaction value crossed ₹1 lakh crore for the first time, driven by festive shopping, dining and online sales.

sectors.title: New-age beauty brands enjoy revenue glow-up
sectors.summary: New-age beauty and personal care brands in India demonstrated impressive revenue growth in fiscal year 2026. Companies like Foxtale and Innovist achieved significant increases, doubling and tripling their sales figures. In contrast, older brands such as Sugar Cosmetics experienced revenue declines due to intensified competition and a lack of product innovation. Many newer brands focus on niche market segments and specific consumer problems to attract customers.
